lines.zh: 我踩着平原的草，一步一步
lines.en: I cross the plains one slow step at a time.

lines.zh: 我的体重让地面发闷响
lines.en: My weight makes the ground thud.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走向下一丛灌木
lines.en: I amble toward the next thicket.

lines.zh: 四条腿撑着我笨重的身子
lines.en: Four legs carry my heavy bulk.
I follow the riverbank hunting tender leaves.
I walk slowly, and no one blocks me.
I press a trail through the grass.
I stop and sniff the wind.

lines.zh: 平原这么大，够我走一天
lines.en: The plains are big enough for a day's walk.
My shadow is longer than the trees.

lines.zh: 我绕开那棵小树，不踩它
lines.en: I step around the sapling instead of crushing it.
My claws swing low at my chest.

lines.zh: 我朝远处的树影挪过去
lines.en: I lumber toward the distant treeline.
Soil kicks up behind me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过庞大的身子
lines.en: I slowly swing my huge body around.
Each step flattens a patch of grass.
I graze as I walk.
I am in no hurry, so do not rush me.

lines.zh: 我站着，像一座长毛的小山
lines.en: I stand like a shaggy hill.
I stare at the leaves, too lazy to move.

lines.zh: 日头把我背上的毛烤暖。
lines.en: The sun warms the fur along my back.
I chew, slow and steady.
The wind swirls deep in my shaggy coat.
I yawn a very long yawn.

lines.zh: 这片草场安静得让我想睡
lines.en: This meadow is quiet enough to sleep in.

lines.zh: 我把重心挪到另一条腿
lines.en: I shift my weight to another leg.

lines.zh: 树上的叶子快被我吃光了
lines.en: I have nearly stripped the branches.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，只有尾巴在摆
lines.en: I hold still, only my tail moving.

lines.zh: 远处有东西在跑，我不追
lines.en: Something runs in the distance, I do not chase.
I lift a foreclaw to a high branch.
My breathing is deep and steady.
I rub my back against a trunk.
Give my stomach a moment.
I squint and listen to the insects.
I have to lower my head just to find you.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，脖子有点酸
lines.en: I look down at you, my neck complaining.
I start nothing, so start nothing.
What leaves are those in your hand?

lines.zh: 我站着不动，就是在看你
lines.en: I stand still, and that means I am watching.
You are close, and I am not sure about you.
You smell of grass.
Turning around will take me a while.
You barely reach my knee.
I blink and shuffle aside.

lines.zh: 这里有我吃的，也有你站的地方
lines.en: There is food for me and room for you.
I watch you, waiting for you to move first.
A low rumble escapes me.
My thick hide is cut.
Such a small wound, I can bear it.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，地面都响了
lines.en: I step back and the ground rings.
I swing my heavy head.
There is a gash in my coat now.
I turn, slowly.
This body is not easy to cut.
It hurts, but I will not run.
I breathe hard, but I stand.
Those leaves look tender.
I smell ripe fruit in the air.
Are you feeding me or tricking me?
I reach out a claw and take it carefully.
A little more, I am not full.

lines.zh: 我这么多体重，得吃很多
lines.en: With this much weight, I need a lot.
I lower my head and chew slowly.
This tastes better than the branches.
I follow your hand.
Do not take it away, I am not done.
I sniff it, then swallow it whole.
My chewing is loud enough to hear.
This will not even fill a tooth gap.

lines.zh: 果子落在草上，我捡起来
lines.en: Dropped fruit on the grass, I pick it up.
I shuffle one step closer.

lines.zh: 我的舌头把碎屑卷走了
lines.en: My tongue sweeps up the crumbs.
You hit my leg like hitting a tree.
I sway, and so do you.

lines.zh: 小心，我踩下去可就重了
lines.en: Careful, my step lands heavy.
Your shove moves me half a step.
This body of mine does not budge easily.

lines.zh: 你从我肚子底下钻过去了
lines.en: You slipped under my belly.
Make way, I am headed for that tree.
Our shoulders brushed.
I look down to see if you are hurt.
Now we have both stopped.
We walk side by side, slowly.

lines.zh: 我给她拨开挡路的枝条
lines.en: I push branches aside for her.

lines.zh: 我们吃的是一样的叶子
lines.en: We eat the same leaves.
This big tree shelters us both.

lines.zh: 我们靠在一起，毛贴着毛
lines.en: We stand together, coat against coat.
I catch her scent.
Neither of us needs to hurry.
She is steadier, so I follow.
This meadow is ours.

lines.zh: 我的声音很低，她听见了
lines.en: My low call reaches her.
Fruit on the ground is mine.
I rake it closer with a claw.
So small, it is gone in one bite.
I try to pinch it with my claws.

lines.zh: 它滚到草里，我找了半天
lines.en: It rolled into the grass and I searched a while.
I pin it under my nose and sniff.
I swallowed dirt along with it.
It is heavy, so I drag it.
My claws are not very nimble.
Whoever dropped it did me a favour.
You stepped on my tender leaves.
This tree is my breakfast.

lines.zh: 我很少生气，但你现在惹我了
lines.en: I rarely get angry, but you have managed it.
My claws are raised.
Back off, I do not want to crush you.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，是因为你太近了
lines.en: I stare because you are too close.
This tree is my lunch.
I turn slowly toward you.
If you take it, I will block you.
I bellow, and the trees shake.

lines.zh: 我还站着，是在给你机会
lines.en: I am still standing, giving you a chance.
Take one more step.
My foreclaw is half a person long.
I am slow, but my claws are not.
I can't be bothered to chase—I'll wait right here.

lines.zh: 我的体重就是我的道理
lines.en: My weight is my argument.
This meadow has rooted me.
My breath bends the grass.
Step back and I will forget it.
I keep my head up, watching your hands.
My claw comes down.

lines.zh: 这一下带着我全身的重量
lines.en: That carried all my weight.
You stagger back several steps.
I did not want this, you forced it.
One swing, and the grass folds.
My claw tip grazes you.
That blow should stick in your memory.
I strike once and stop.
The ground cracks where I strike.
There. Now go away.

lines.zh: 大地懒从平原尽头走来
lines.en: The Megatherium walks in from the plain's edge.

lines.zh: 我从南方的草原一路过来
lines.en: I have come from the southern grasslands.
The grass here is tall enough to hide me.

lines.zh: 我的脚步先到，影子后到
lines.en: My footsteps arrive before my shadow.
I smell fresh pasture.

lines.zh: 平原上多了一座会走的山
lines.en: The plains have gained a walking hill.

lines.zh: 我慢慢抬头，看清这片地
lines.en: I raise my head to read the land.

lines.zh: 风把我的气味送得很远
lines.en: The wind carries my scent far.

lines.zh: 我第一次踩在这片草上
lines.en: My first step on this grass.
Do not panic, I am only looking at the grass.
Let me find a tree and rest.
It is quiet here, so I will stay.
Fire singes my coat and it stings.

lines.zh: 我从高处滑下，摔得很闷
lines.en: I slide off a height and land hard.

lines.zh: 水淹到我的鼻子，我呛住了
lines.en: Water reaches my nose and I choke.
The blast shoves me off balance.
An arrow lodges in my thick hide.

lines.zh: 魔法打在身上，凉得刺骨
lines.en: Magic bites cold into my side.
I have gone too long without leaves.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，我站不稳
lines.en: Lightning strikes my back and I sway.
The ground beneath me is gone.
